note: Written before reading the six reports, from my own measurements of the artifacts as captured this session. The rule is the lower of critic and builder per category, so a number here is a ceiling on what I claim. Cycle 4's completeness pass found four things all six critics missed; three of the six fixes below come straight out of it.
what_i_will_not_argue_with: 09_two_devices.png and 16_setup_android.png are absent. No /dev/kvm; the three routes tried are measured in docs/PHONES.md; nothing stands in for them.

08 is required to show both devices' screens in sequence and shows one. The far phone is the app's spine in the host role and has no screen by construction, and a browser page cannot take that role because the host binds a listening socket. Written down in docs/PHONES.md.
Every reliability report says transport: local. coldstart.json records a real two-node tailnet run from the session that had a key; this session had none and the brief forbids asking again.

DeskStamp is not built — about five hours on one core here — so every tab, stamp, module label and margin note is set in Teo's handwriting, and notifications.dart has seventeen arms for eighteen types.
The seeded photographs are renders and the darkest few read as renders.

The contact shadow is faint. Measured on this hero: the desk within ten pixels of a note is median 98 against 102 on open desk. That is four grey levels where the last two cycles measured zero, and I would not call four a resting shadow if I were reading it cold.
The desk hairline pitch a critic measured in cycle 3 has never been reproduced by me. Two methods are recorded in blender/shell/desk.py. If it comes back it stands.

messenger_reliability.why: Twelve seeded scenes paired and connected on the whole year; 13 stages send, sent, read, in flight, refused, a reaction, a reply, an edit through the composer's own path and a row taken back; 02 carries nine notes on nine different torn edges with six kinds of paper among them, the voice note and the video included; 14 opens the video in the viewer and plays it. Held back by the missing second device, by transport: local, by a first launch that still costs twelve seconds, and by thirty per cent of frames costing a second to build, which nobody has yet found.

material_truth.why: Two defects that stood through four cycles are gone. Paper casts a shadow onto the desk again: a Stack clips to its bounds by default and the baked shadow is framed a quarter wider than the piece, so every visible part of every contact shadow in the app was being cut off. And a window onto a sheet is drawn at one image pixel per device pixel rather than per logical point, so the tab strip is no longer three-times-magnified and smoothed — the shape the anti-goal forbids was in the app's own permanent chrome. Repeated letters sit at a twin share of 0.102 on the hero, against 0.30 two cycles ago; all 240 fold frames are above the paper floor. Held back because the shadow is four grey levels, because DeskStamp is unbuilt, and because I have not compared any of it with a photograph of real paper.

emotional_transmission.why: 07 is four arrivals on three surfaces over 6.74 s with the pattern annotated and no words on it. Every feeling's object now has its own render under the desk lamp — the candle drops 40.8 grey levels and its red-minus-blue goes from 22 to 57 — so an object at dusk is no longer the one thing in the frame lit by daylight. 15 goes through the vocabulary family by family and ends on the couple's own. Held back because there is still no vibrator in the evidence, because the clip's sound is the asset file rather than the app's output, and because the two-device frame this row turns on does not exist.

coherence.why: One stock per event type, with a test. A torn edge comes from the event's own sequence number, so the same note is the same paper on every surface — it was the row index, which tore one event two ways in two regions and gave twelve search results one identical edge. All five shared-life modules are on the Us desk at once, which is the brief's own test of the architecture and which the still showed two of. Held back because nothing in the capture shows the Android side, and because the code half of this row is not mine to judge.

anti_goal.why: The flat-rectangle-with-a-drop-shadow that sat in the tab strip on ten of eleven stills is gone at its cause. No emoji shapes, no prize tokens, no counts, no badges, no streaks; the voice lint names its rules and lists all 115 strings. The instrument readout is off the picture and the annotation that remains carries no words. Held back because the seeded photographs still read as renders, and because a capture-only lane on the frame is furniture however carefully it is placed.

measurements.clip_rule: 62.5 frames a second, the rate the app's clock was stepped at; every clip zero repeats, zero jumps

contact_shadow.cycle4: no difference in any direction at any distance
